paper.title_en: A New Approach to Black Hole Thermodynamics in General EMD-like Theories
paper.abstract_en: We consider general EMD-like theories involving arbitrary numbers of both Maxwell fields and dilatonic scalars. We study charged black holes and derive several algebraic and differential relations among the thermodynamic quantities, scalar charges and the non-extremal parameter. These allow us to obtain two sets of master equations of thermodynamic quantities, depending on the choice of basic variables parameterizing the system. Solutions to either set of the master equations give rise to all the thermodynamic quantities, without constructing black hole solutions. We obtain all the thermodynamic quantities perturbatively in the power series expansions of charges, which we then verify using perturbative black hole solutions up to and including the quartic order in charges.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文提出了在广义EMD类理论中不构造黑洞解即可获得全部热力学量的主方程方法，理论深度较高且与黑洞热力学直接相关，适合研究者深入阅读。
decision.title_zh: 广义EMD类理论中黑洞热力学的一种新方法
decision.abstract_zh: 我们考虑广义的EMD类理论，其中包含任意数量的Maxwell场和伸缩子标量场。我们研究带电黑洞，并推导出热力学量、标量荷与非极端参数之间的若干代数与微分关系。这些关系使我们能够获得两组热力学量的主方程，具体取决于参数化系统所选择的基本变量。任一组主方程的解都能给出所有热力学量，而无需构造黑洞解。我们以电荷的幂级数展开微扰地获得所有热力学量，随后利用微扰黑洞解在电荷的四阶及以下验证了这些结果。
